create_mephisto_vpc: create a VPC with two subnets, an internet gateway, and routing tables in us-east-2
create_instance: create an EC2 instance with a specified key pair, security group, subnet, and volume size
create_load_balancer: create an internet-facing application load balancer across the given subnets and security group
cleanup_fallback_server: cleanup and delete all EC2, ELB, VPC, and security group resources from a server details file
deploy_fallback_server: deploy the fallback server files to an EC2 instance via scp and run first setup
